lines.en: I still walk upright, on two feet.

lines.zh: 我走路的样子，像不太确定。
lines.en: I walk as if unsure.
One of my arms is longer than the other.
I go along the wall, holding on to it.
I stop at every step, as if listening.

lines.zh: 我身上的衣服，还认得出来。
lines.en: My clothes are still recognizable.
An ordinary coat.
The grass blackens where I pass.
I walk toward the voices.
I can't remember where I was going.
My legs keep going anyway.
I go along with them.
I stand, and one shoulder keeps moving.
I turn my hand over and look at the palm.
One finger too many.
I count them twice.
The same both times.

lines.zh: 我的指节自己弯了一下。
lines.en: One knuckle bends on its own.

lines.zh: 声音是从我自己身上来的。
lines.en: It's coming from me.

lines.zh: 这具身体已经不太会疼。
lines.en: This body has mostly stopped hurting.
I slowly pull my sleeve down.
Covering it is enough.
Your clothes are a lot like mine.
Do you live near here too?
I don't remember the neighbours' faces.
I remember their dog.
You've stepped back a little.
I understand all of that.

lines.zh: 我这只手，不太像人的了。
lines.en: This arm of mine isn't very human now.
I put it behind my back.
Does that look better?
Don't force yourself.
I fall and push myself up.

lines.zh: 我的手在地上撑出一个坑。
lines.en: My hand leaves a hollow in the ground.
That put me back a long way.
I don't blame you for this.
If I were you, I'd hit too.
Blood comes out of my sleeve.
I press my hand over the wound.

lines.zh: 我的伤口不流血，只发麻。
lines.en: My wound doesn't bleed; it only numbs.
I lift my face to you.
Go, while I can still hold it.

lines.zh: 那味道，像我从前的晚饭。
lines.en: That smell is like my old supper.
I used to eat that.
My fingers shake; I pull them into a fist.
My fingertips are moving on their own.
I'm not hungry, only remembering.

lines.zh: 我不太确定吃下去会怎样。
lines.en: I'm not sure what would happen if I did.
It may be no use to me now.
I stand there and look at it a long while.
In the end I turn away.

lines.zh: 同化之后，我不吃这个了。
lines.en: Assimilated, I no longer eat that.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，我让开了。
lines.en: You bumped me and I moved aside.
My hand brushed your sleeve.
It'll leave a mark.
It won't wash out. It fades in a few days.
I back off, a few paces away.
That was me not watching the road.
I nod to you.
I still remember how to do that.
I remember I should say sorry.
I bumped you. Sorry.
I have a wife.
She still lives in the village.

lines.zh: 我在篱笆外面看过她一次。
lines.en: I watched her once from outside the fence.
She was hanging out washing.
I didn't call out.
If I had, she'd have come over.
And then she'd have seen my hand.
I stood there until dark, then left.
I'll go again.
Only I won't call out to her.
I bend down and pick up a piece of clothing.
This coat is the wrong size.
I fold it anyway.
I set the button on the windowsill.
Someone will come looking.
I pick up a button.

lines.zh: 我衣服上缺的就是这个。
lines.en: This is the one missing from my coat.
I press it into place.
The button won't hold.
I close my hand around it.
Someone's ahead.
He's carrying something, not walking fast.
I stop at the fork.
I don't want to frighten him.
I move to the side of the road.
He comes right up to the roadside.
He glances at me.
He quickens his pace.
I stand at the crossing and step aside.
He turns the corner and is gone.
I stand there a while longer.
I go around him into the fields.
I used to walk this road every day.
Now I walk it slower.
The road still goes the same way.

lines.zh: 我跟在他后面，隔着一段。
lines.en: I follow him at a distance.
He looks back and I stop.
Only when he moves on do I walk.
That way he isn't afraid.
He reaches the fork.
He took the left fork.
So I go left as well.
He rounds the house at a run.
I stand and don't follow.

lines.zh: 我抬起胳膊，它又垂下去。
lines.en: I lift my arm and it drops again.
I remember this gesture.
It used to be a greeting.
It doesn't look like one now.
I turn and take the other road.
There's a boundary stone at the fork.
I've stood by it many times.
A little longer today.
Then I went back.
I catch his shoulder.
More strength than I expected.
He pulls free and backs off far.
I look at my own hand.
It was my hand that moved first.
I reach out again.
This time I hold it down.
My hand is twisting the wrong way.
I go down on one knee.
He's already run off.
He ran fast.
I sit on the ground, breathing hard.
The hand is still moving.
I pin it under my knee.
That'll hold it a while.
I've closed my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从一间空屋里走出来。
lines.en: I walk out of an empty house.
There are three place settings on the table.
Two are clean.
The lamp in the window is not one I know.
Then I pull the door shut.
The sky outside is grey.
Someone's chopping wood at the village edge.
I went around him.
I remember his name.
I didn't call his name.
I head out into the fields.
There's no one in the fields.

lines.zh: 门槛上还留着我的鞋印。
lines.en: My boot print is still on the sill.
There's still a light in the window.

lines.zh: 火燎到外套，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my coat and I slap it out.

lines.zh: 我从屋顶上摔下来，落地很闷。
lines.en: I fall from the roof and land heavily.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，它却在水里动。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth, and it moves in the water.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀翻，我爬起来。
lines.en: The blast throws me down and I get up.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在我背上，我拔了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back. I pull it out.

lines.zh: 一道光在烧我身体里的东西。
lines.en: A light is burning the thing inside me.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃了，也不太想吃。
lines.en: I haven't eaten in a long time, and don't much want to.

lines.zh: 雷落下，我身上麻了一下。
lines.en: Lightning falls and a numbness runs through me.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，手还在往上伸。
lines.en: I fall, and the hand still reaches up.
